findings.label: Dead code block in heartbeat.sh
findings.description: The Linux agent has a full duplicate of its collection and heartbeat logic after the `exit 0` on approximately line 104. It is unreachable but roughly doubles the file length and will mislead maintainers. Remove everything after the `exit 0`.

findings.label: Hardcoded command-server URL in heartbeat.ps1
findings.description: $CommandServer is set unconditionally to 'http://192.168.8.10:8000/api/agent/commands', ignoring $env:LOCAL_BASE_URL. Any deployment that changes the server address will heartbeat correctly but fail to receive commands. Derive $CommandServer from the same env-var logic used for $Server.

findings.label: Container type absent from frontend filters
findings.description: DeviceType includes 'container' and the backend accepts it, but DEVICE_TYPE_OPTIONS in LiveStatusPage.tsx and InventoryPage.tsx only offer 'physical' and 'vm'. An endpoint that registers as 'container' cannot be isolated via the type filter. Add a container option or restrict the backend choices to match the UI.
